implementation_commit.metadata_commit_policy: This manifest, its contract test, sanitized preview projections, and documentation may follow in one metadata-only commit. A collector, compiler, query-plan, or sampling-protocol change requires a new collector implementation lock and newly compiled plans. A selector change requires a new lane-specific selection implementation lock and invalidates every later selection receipt, task artifact, preview, and approval bound to the old lock.

relationship_to_descriptive_campaign.claim_separation: The three descriptive previews cover authored benchmarks only and have not executed. Population-frame evidence requires separately acquired, reviewed, authenticated, selected, powered, task-qualified, previewed, and approved Studies; this population work does not retroactively authorize or mutate the descriptive previews.

collector.role: bounded public GitHub acquisition with repeated-query, visibility, drift, privacy, and provenance receipts

compiler.role: strict query-and-protocol compiler bound to the implementation commit

generic_selector.role: Superpowers and Anthropic structural validation with fail-closed authenticated selection boundary

vercel_selector.role: Vercel authenticated source, review, beacon, power, allocation, and replacement validation

common_selection_invariants: every frozen population record receives exactly one eligibility-ledger decision
two independent reviewers agree or an independent adjudicator resolves the record
attempts never increase the independent task count
a preparation failure requires a new frame identity rather than investigator replacement
a blocked selector emits no assignment, seed, objective, replacement order, preview, or experiment authority
generic_selection_invariants: one externally randomized record is retained per independence cluster before stratum allocation
every selected partition receives its preregistered slice of one frozen stratum permutation
inclusion probabilities and inverse-probability weights are emitted per selected task
vercel_selection_invariants: the complete eligible lineage-to-slot graph is allocated with exact minimum-cost flow and deterministic owner-constraint branching
one task is selected per public code-lineage cluster across all partitions
exact family and partition quotas plus all-partition and holdout owner caps must hold
development and holdout identities remain disjoint
replacement is non-executable until a reviewed complete residual-augmentation artifact is frozen

superpowers_writing_plans.temporal_estimand: post-treatment public maintenance records in the frozen query-discoverable observation window

anthropic_skill_creator.temporal_estimand: primary pre-treatment public Skill-package repository frame

vercel_react_best_practices.temporal_estimand: primary pre-treatment test-qualified public TypeScript Next.js repair frame
vercel_react_best_practices.feasibility: exact RSC family yield and powered quotas remain unproven until both acquisitions, review, lineage collapse, and prospective power analysis complete

historical_live_pilot.qualified_claim: The historical diagnostic demonstrated one bounded authenticated GitHub Search query, complete pagination, omission of known credential header and environment fields from its receipt, non-copying of the one matched token-shaped source value into that receipt, and candidate-only output. This is not a global credential non-leakage qualification. It did not use the committed V3 implementation lock and does not establish a public population, authenticated selection, task validity, experiment result, or community claim.

next_gates: Commit this manifest, its contract test, and documentation without changing any implementation, query-plan, or sampling-protocol byte; recompile all plans and require identical canonical digests.
Obtain explicit operator authorization for read-only public GitHub acquisition, then run two live acquisitions per lane at least 3600 seconds apart using the exact committed implementation lock.
Finalize each acquisition only after exact drift, pagination, repository-publicness, provenance, privacy, and transaction receipts pass; preserve a complete exclusion ledger.
Complete calibrated blinded review, adjudication, immutable lineage clustering, and source-authenticated evidence under separated roles.
Register prospective authenticated selector trust roots or amendments before any selection; publish the precommit and independently verifiable randomness evidence before allocation.
Run frame-specific prospective power analysis and stop or narrow the estimand if the preregistered quotas are infeasible.
Author public tasks and mode-0600 private labels under separated roles, then validate base failure and gold success or no-change truth.
Generate new population-study previews and exact approvals only after every prior gate; this manifest authorizes no network acquisition, model call, experiment cell, or spend.
